bounded_baseline_rows.falsifier: Residual exceeds display-truncation tolerance or Planck-only control is not worse
bounded_baseline_rows.support_scope: target-blind reconstruction of a held-out CODATA relationship from exact defining constants; not a novel physics law

bounded_baseline_rows.comparator_baseline: CO2 molecular-weight negative control against water target
bounded_baseline_rows.falsifier: Residual exceeds declared uncertainty or CO2 control is not worse than formula reconstruction
bounded_baseline_rows.support_scope: target-blind reconstruction of a held-out official snapshot field; not a novel chemistry law

bounded_baseline_rows.comparator_baseline: use total hit count as pagination-size negative control
bounded_baseline_rows.falsifier: Retmax differs from retstart plus returned id count or total-count control is not worse
bounded_baseline_rows.support_scope: target-blind reconstruction of a held-out NCBI/GEO API snapshot field; not a biological mechanism law

bounded_baseline_rows.falsifier: Held-out residual exceeds 1 percent of observed target or comparator is not worse
bounded_baseline_rows.support_scope: retrospective target-blind holdout over pinned WDI rows; not a prospective macroeconomic law

bounded_baseline_rows.comparator_baseline: ungated theorem-case count, which ignores certificate/source binding failures
bounded_baseline_rows.falsifier: Certificate/source binding becomes clean and the gated machine_checked_subset_total differs from the row, or the ungated control is not worse
bounded_baseline_rows.support_scope: not promoted as bounded support until source_manifest_binding_ok is true and certificate_binding_failure_total is zero; the row records a demotion boundary, not support

grand_toe_support_scope: false at the empirical gate; empirical-domain support is not TOE/final-theory promotion and does not claim broad modern-science superiority
support_policy: A domain is unresolved unless an evidence pack demonstrates target-blind or prospective source separation, per-domain N at or above the configured minimum, comparator superiority, uncertainty, residuals, negative controls, and falsifiers. Existing OC133 target-blind rows are admissible only as bounded baseline evidence and do not permit grand TOE support.
no_fabricated_pass_policy: This factory/gate emits only bounded empirical-domain support from qualifying packs. It does not emit TOE, final-theory, broad modern-science coverage, or modern-science superiority promotion from bounded OC133 reconstructions, sample packs, or artifact existence. Unresolved domains remain BLOCKED until prospective or target-blind evidence packs clear the configured criteria.
